eod.conclusion: Indian equities extended gains for a third consecutive session, with benchmarks closing modestly higher after relinquishing stronger intraday advances. The Nifty and Sensex both edged upward alongside a sharper rise in banking stocks, while plummeting volatility levels supported the bullish undertone. Market participants remained focused on upcoming earnings reports that could drive individual stock performance, even as global attention turned to tech earnings and cryptocurrency markets staged significant rallies.
